work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter XXXVI (printed EPISTOLA ENCYCLICA, ad perpetuam rei memoriam) condemns the 1806 Melkite synod of Qarqafe and forbids its book; LF7172 → LF7181 across top-margin specks LF7175–7178; LF7248 → LF7260 across provenance LF7251, mark LF7254 and running-title part LF7257; complete 3 June 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7127–7127; the source closing at LF7291–7294 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die tertia iunii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
